title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1968-10-13

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of the Oct 13 1968 Avalon Ballroom show, highlighted by a soaring Dark Star, an epic The Eleven and superb Death Don't Have No Mercy.
ai_review.review: The Charlie Miller/ Michael Owen sound‑board capture is crystal‑clear and preserves the original 1968 vibe, making it a must‑have for any early‑Dead collection. Musically the concert shines with a near‑perfect Dark Star, an electrifying The Eleven, and Jerry’s masterful Death Don't Have No Mercy; the first set outshines the second, though New Potato and the drum segment are noted as weaker moments.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviewers give 4‑5 stars and praise both performance and recording; minor set‑list criticisms do not outweigh the overall excellence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Soundboard source with crisp, balanced mix; no dropouts or muddiness reported. Reviewers repeatedly call it “original sound” and give top marks to the mix.

poor_songs: Drums (less interesting than earlier drum work)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is generally praised as superior; the transition St. Stephen → The Eleven is highlighted for its natural flow, while the second set suffers from a jarring New Potato‑drum splice and a less compelling drum segment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Top‑notch guitar work on Dark Star and Death Don't Have No Mercy; feeding off the band’s energy.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass playing praised for locking in with the drummers, contributing to the overall groove.
band_member_comments.Drums: Fabulous early‑set drumming noted; later drum segment considered less interesting.
